```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Load libraries
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)

```

# Data summary
```{r, echo = FALSE}
## Table containing row counts, missing-value counts, mean, median, standard deviation.
summary_stats <- params$screenData %>%
  group_by(experimentID) %>%
  summarise(
    row_count     = n(),
    missing_count = sum(is.na(viab_norm)),
    mean_viab     = mean(viab_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_viab   = median(viab_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_viab       = sd(viab_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
kable(summary_stats, caption = "Summary Statistics by Experiment ID")
```
## Box plot of raw data values by plate
```{r, echo = FALSE}

df <- params$screenData
df$y = as.factor(df$experimentID)
#if log10, adjust x
if (!params$log10) {
    df$x <- df$raw_count
    xlab <- "Raw Count"
} else {
    df$x <- log(df$raw_count, base = 10)
    xlab <- "Raw Count (scaled by log10)"
}

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "royalblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Raw Count Distribution by Experiment",
    x = xlab,
    y = "Experiment ID"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# Quality Control metrics
## Z-prime Factor (requires positive and negative)
```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Check if positive controls exist in the dataset
has_pos_control <- "control" %in% names(params$screenData) &&
                   any(params$screenData$control == "pos", na.rm = TRUE)

if (has_pos_control) {
  # Path 1: Positive controls exist -> Calculate all 4 metrics
  metrics_df <- params$screenData %>%
    filter(control %in% c("pos", "neg")) %>%
    group_by(experimentID) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pos = mean(raw_count[control == "pos"], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_pos   = sd(raw_count[control == "pos"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_neg = mean(raw_count[control == "neg"], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_neg   = sd(raw_count[control == "neg"], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      z_prime  = 1 - (3 * (sd_pos + sd_neg)) / abs(mean_pos - mean_neg),
      stb      = mean_pos / mean_neg,
      cv_pos   = 100 * sd_pos / mean_pos,
      cv_neg   = 100 * sd_neg / mean_neg
    )

  cat("### Assay Quality Metrics (Z-prime, Signal-to-Background, & CV)\n")
  print(kable(metrics_df, caption = "Comprehensive Quality Metrics per Experiment"))

} else {
  # Path 2: No positive controls -> Calculate CV for negative controls only
  metrics_df <- params$screenData %>%
    filter(control == "neg") %>%
    group_by(experimentID) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_neg = mean(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_neg   = sd(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cv_neg = 100 * sd_neg / mean_neg
    )

  cat("### Assay Quality Metrics (Negative Control CV)\n")
  cat("> *Note: Positive control wells ('pos') were not found in the dataset. Z-prime and Signal-to-Background require positive controls; showing Coefficient of Variation for negative controls only.*\n\n")
  print(kable(metrics_df, caption = "Negative Control CV per Experiment"))
}
```

# Spatial visualizations

## PCA (if possible)
```{r, echo = FALSE}
# 1. Reshape data: Wells become columns, experiments become rows
pca_wide <- params$screenData %>%
  select(experimentID, WellID, viab_norm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = WellID, values_from = viab_norm)

# 2. Extract metadata and prepare the numeric matrix for PCA
# Note: standard PCA cannot handle missing (NA) values.
# We keep track of valid experiments after dropping rows with NAs.
valid_indices <- complete.cases(pca_wide %>% select(-experimentID))
pca_matrix <- pca_wide[valid_indices, ] %>% select(-experimentID)
valid_experiments <- pca_wide$experimentID[valid_indices]

if (nrow(pca_matrix) > 2) {
  # 3. Run PCA (scaling is important since well values can have variance differences)
  pca_res <- prcomp(pca_matrix, scale. = TRUE)
  
  # 4. Extract PC1 and PC2 coordinates for plotting
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    experimentID = valid_experiments,
    PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2]
  )
  
  # Calculate variance explained percentages for axis labels
  var_explained <- summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100
  
  # 5. Plot using ggplot2
  p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = experimentID)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkorange") +
    geom_text(vjust = -1.2, size = 3.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = "PCA of Plate/Experiment Profiles",
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)")
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  
  print(p_pca)
  
} else {
  cat("> *Note: Not enough complete cases (non-missing rows) across the well layout to perform PCA.*\n")
}
```

## Mean variance vs Rank

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# 1. Per-Plate Variance/SD vs Mean Rank (using raw_count)
perPlateVar <- params$screenData %>%
  mutate(log10Val = log10(raw_count)) %>% 
  group_by(experimentID) %>% 
  summarise(
    meanRaw = mean(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sdRaw   = sd(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    meanLog = mean(log10Val, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sdLog   = sd(log10Val, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

customTheme <- theme_bw() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

p1 <- perPlateVar %>% 
  arrange(meanRaw) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = sdRaw)) + 
  geom_point(color = "royalblue", alpha = 0.8) + 
  xlab("Rank (Mean)") + ylab("Standard Deviation") +
  ggtitle("Per-Plate (Raw)") + customTheme

p2 <- perPlateVar %>% 
  arrange(meanLog) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = sdLog)) + 
  geom_point(color = "royalblue", alpha = 0.8) + 
  xlab("Rank (Mean)") + ylab("Standard Deviation") +
  ggtitle("Per-Plate (Log10 Scale)") + customTheme

# 2. Per-Well Variance/SD vs Mean Rank (using raw_count)
perWellVar <- params$screenData %>%
  mutate(log10Val = log10(raw_count)) %>% 
  group_by(WellID) %>%
  summarise(
    meanRaw = mean(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sdRaw   = sd(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    meanLog = mean(log10Val, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sdLog   = sd(log10Val, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p3 <- perWellVar %>% 
  arrange(meanRaw) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = sdRaw)) + 
  geom_point(color = "firebrick", alpha = 0.8) + 
  xlab("Rank (Mean)") + ylab("Standard Deviation") +
  ggtitle("Per-Well (Raw)") + customTheme

p4 <- perWellVar %>% 
  arrange(meanLog) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = sdLog)) + 
  geom_point(color = "firebrick", alpha = 0.8) + 
  xlab("Rank (Mean)") + ylab("Standard Deviation") +
  ggtitle("Per-Well (Log10 Scale)") + customTheme

# 3. Arrange into a 2x2 grid
grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)
```
